title: IDKMesh Human Decision Record v0.1
description: A recorded, accountable human integration decision against one immutable Run Evidence Report. It captures who decided, what was decided, when, and why, bound to the report by content digest so a swapped or corrupted report is detectable. It is a record of a decision that was made, not an executor of that decision: it carries no canonical-state-write, git-push, or merge authority of its own.

digest.description: canonical_digest() of the exact evidence-report document this decision was made against. A decision record whose digest no longer matches the referenced report's current content is stale/tampered evidence, not a valid decision.

selected_attempt_id.description: The attempt_id (from the referenced evidence report's attempts[]) this decision applies to, or null when the decision concerns the run as a whole rather than one attempt.

decision.description: The human's own explicit choice. This is deliberately a distinct vocabulary from the machine-suggested decision_support.recommendation values (accept_candidate/reject_candidate/escalate/insufficient_evidence) carried by the evidence report: recording a decision here is never satisfied by echoing that recommendation.
